roadmapTask: Horizon 6 of FeatureSync: reproducible CI via pinned snapshots — add a CLI `pull` command to @featuresync/cli, backed by a snapshot fetcher in @featuresync/aws, that downloads a chosen (pinned) Snapshot Version from the S3 layout to a local file consumed via FEATURESYNC_FILE. Production bar: 100% coverage, ESLint layer zones, LocalStack integration proof.
